The bug is in `AbstractCategoryItemRenderer.getLegendItems()`.

Diagnosis:
- The method creates an empty `LegendItemCollection`.
- It gets the renderer index from the plot, then fetches the dataset:
  - `int index = this.plot.getIndexOf(this);`
  - `CategoryDataset dataset = this.plot.getDataset(index);`
- It then does:
  - `if (dataset != null) { return result; }`

That condition is backwards.

Why this is wrong:
- In the failing test, the plot has a valid `DefaultCategoryDataset` with one series/value.
- Runtime verification confirmed `dataset` is non-null at the check.
- Because of the inverted condition, the method immediately returns the still-empty legend collection.
- As a result, it never reaches:
  - `int seriesCount = dataset.getRowCount();`
  - the loop that adds legend items.

This exactly explains the failure:
- expected legend item count: `1`
- actual legend item count: `0`

Correct behavior:
- The guard should return early only when `dataset == null`, not when it is non-null.

So the root cause is an inverted null check in:
`org.jfree.chart.renderer.category.AbstractCategoryItemRenderer.getLegendItems()`

READY
The bug is in `AbstractCategoryItemRenderer.getLegendItems()`.

Diagnosis:
- The method creates an empty `LegendItemCollection`.
- It gets the renderer index from the plot, then fetches the dataset:
  - `int index = this.plot.getIndexOf(this);`
  - `CategoryDataset dataset = this.plot.getDataset(index);`
- It then does:
  - `if (dataset != null) { return result; }`

That condition is backwards.

Why this is wrong:
- In the failing test, the plot has a valid `DefaultCategoryDataset` with one series/value.
- Runtime verification confirmed `dataset` is non-null at the check.
- Because of the inverted condition, the method immediately returns the still-empty legend collection.
- As a result, it never reaches:
  - `int seriesCount = dataset.getRowCount();`
  - the loop that adds legend items.

This exactly explains the failure:
- expected legend item count: `1`
- actual legend item count: `0`

Correct behavior:
- The guard should return early only when `dataset == null`, not when it is non-null.

So the root cause is an inverted null check in:
`org.jfree.chart.renderer.category.AbstractCategoryItemRenderer.getLegendItems()`
